What should I have ready when I call?+

Your pickup location, vehicle make and model, a description of the problem, and your destination if you need a tow.

Are you open on weekends?+

Dave Towing’s supplied business information says open 7 days. Call to confirm today’s hours and availability.

How much will service cost?+

Call for a quote for your situation. Share the service needed, vehicle details, pickup location, and destination. Confirm the price before arranging assistance.

What areas do you serve?+

Call with your pickup location to confirm coverage. A verified service boundary has not been provided.

How soon can you get here?+

Call Dave to confirm current availability and an estimated arrival time. No fixed response time is promised.

Can I choose a repair shop?+

Tell Dave your preferred destination so you can confirm the towing arrangement.

What details should I share?+

Have your location, vehicle details, and a description of the problem ready. Mention access restrictions.

Can every vehicle be unlocked?+

Vehicle security systems vary. Call with your vehicle details to confirm whether assistance is suitable.

Will a jump start fix my battery?+

A jump start may help a discharged battery start a vehicle. It does not diagnose or repair an underlying battery or charging-system problem.

Do I need a spare tire?+

This service is described for vehicles with a usable spare. Tell Dave if you do not have one to discuss next steps.
